```{ojs}
//| echo: false
buildQuiz = function(id, title, questions) {
  const outer = html`<div id="${id}" style="margin:18px 0 24px 0;text-align:center;">
    <button style="
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea 0%,#764ba2 100%);
      color:#fff;border:none;padding:9px 22px;border-radius:50px;
      font-size:.95em;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
      box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(102,126,234,.45);
      transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s;"
      onmouseover="this.style.transform='scale(1.04)';this.style.boxShadow='0 5px 18px rgba(102,126,234,.55)'"
      onmouseout="this.style.transform='scale(1)';this.style.boxShadow='0 3px 12px rgba(102,126,234,.45)'"
    >
      <span style="font-size:1.1em;">📝</span> ${title}
      <span class="chevron" style="transition:transform .3s;">▼</span>
    </button>
    <div class="quiz-body" style="
      max-height:0;opacity:0;overflow:hidden;
      transition:max-height .5s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),opacity .4s ease,margin-top .3s ease;
      margin-top:0;text-align:left;">
      <button class="close-btn" style="
        display:block;margin:0 auto 10px auto;
        background:rgba(102,126,234,.12);color:#667eea;border:none;
        padding:5px 18px;border-radius:50px;font-size:.85em;
        font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Hide Quiz</button>
      <p style="text-align:center;color:#718096;font-style:italic;font-size:.9em;margin-bottom:12px;">
        Select an answer for each question.</p>
    </div>
  </div>`;
  const toggle = outer.querySelector("button");
  const chevron = toggle.querySelector(".chevron");
  const body   = outer.querySelector(".quiz-body");
  const closeBtn = body.querySelector(".close-btn");
  function expand(){  body.style.maxHeight="2000px";body.style.opacity="1";body.style.marginTop="14px";chevron.style.transform="rotate(180deg)"; }
  function collapse(){ body.style.maxHeight="0";body.style.opacity="0";body.style.marginTop="0";chevron.style.transform="rotate(0)"; }
  toggle.onclick = () => body.style.maxHeight === "0px" || body.style.maxHeight === "" ? expand() : collapse();
  closeBtn.onclick = collapse;
  questions.forEach((qq, qi) => {
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.style.cssText = "background:#fff;color:#1e1b4b;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08);";
    card.innerHTML = `<p style="font-weight:700;margin:0 0 10px;">${qi+1}. ${qq.q}</p>`;
    qq.options.forEach((opt, oi) => {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.textContent = opt;
      btn.style.cssText = "display:block;width:100%;min-height:44px;text-align:left;padding:10px 14px;margin:6px 0;border:2px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#1e1b4b;cursor:pointer;font-size:.95em;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s;";
      btn.onmouseover = () => { if(!card.dataset.answered){ btn.style.borderColor="#667eea";btn.style.background="#f0f0ff"; }};
      btn.onmouseout  = () => { if(!card.dataset.answered){ btn.style.borderColor="#e2e8f0";btn.style.background="#fff"; }};
      btn.onclick = () => {
        if(card.dataset.answered) return;
        card.dataset.answered = "true";
        card.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => { b.style.cursor="default"; b.onmouseover=null; b.onmouseout=null; });
        if(oi === qq.correct){
          btn.style.borderColor="#48bb78";btn.style.background="#f0fff4";
          fb.innerHTML = "✅ Correct! " + qq.explanation;
          fb.style.color="#276749";fb.style.background="#f0fff4";
        } else {
          btn.style.borderColor="#fc8181";btn.style.background="#fff5f5";
          card.querySelectorAll("button")[qq.correct].style.borderColor="#48bb78";
          card.querySelectorAll("button")[qq.correct].style.background="#f0fff4";
          fb.innerHTML = "❌ " + qq.explanation;
          fb.style.color="#9b2c2c";fb.style.background="#fff5f5";
        }
        fb.style.padding="10px 14px";fb.style.marginTop="8px";
      };
      card.appendChild(btn);
    });
    const fb = document.createElement("div");
    fb.style.cssText = "border-radius:8px;font-size:.9em;transition:all .3s;";
    card.appendChild(fb);
    body.appendChild(card);
  });
  return outer;
}
```

# Tell the Story: Evolution of Life on Earth

::: {.engage-box}
## 🌍 4.5 Billion Years in Three Texts

<div style="font-size: 1.25em; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; margin: 20px 0;">
Earth is about 4.54 billion years old. Humans have been here for only about 300,000 of those years. What happened in between, and why did it take so long?
</div>

**Directions from your PTO:**

1. Silently read or watch each "text."
2. Record **three details** from each text that are most important to the phenomenon.
3. Share with your group. Each person names the details they circled.
4. Discuss as a group: **What is the overall story? What is the phenomenon?**
:::

## Text 1: The History of Life on Earth

Watch the video below. As you watch, look for details about:

- **When** major groups of living things first appeared
- **How long** life stayed simple (single-celled) before it became complex
- **What changed** on Earth (oceans, atmosphere, climate) that made new life possible
- **Disasters** that wiped out life, and what evolved afterward

## Text 2: Mass Extinctions

Your PTO's poster, **"Mass Extinctions: The biggest disasters in history,"** shows five events. The death rate is the share of species that died out. Tap a bar or pick an extinction to see its likely causes and results.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  title: "The Five Mass Extinctions",
  subtitle: "Death rate (% of species lost) vs. time. Data from the PTO's Mass Extinctions poster.",
  width: width,
  height: 320,
  marginLeft: 46,
  marginBottom: 46,
  x: {label: width < 460 ? "Extinction" : "Extinction (millions of years ago)", domain: extinctionData.map(d => d.name), tickFormat: n => { const d = extinctionData.find(e => e.name === n); return width < 460 ? n : `${n} (${d.mya})`; }},
  y: {label: "Death rate (%)", domain: [0, 100], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(extinctionData, {x: "name", y: "rate", fill: d => d.name === extPick ? "#d63031" : "#fab1a0", tip: true,
      title: d => `${d.name}: ${d.rate}% of species lost\n${d.mya} million years ago\nCauses: ${d.causes.join(", ")}`}),
    Plot.text(extinctionData, {x: "name", y: "rate", text: d => `${d.rate}%`, dy: -8, fontWeight: "bold", fill: "currentColor"}),

  ]
})
```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## 🔎 About the dates

The PTO poster rounds its dates. Many sources place the Devonian extinction closer to **372 million years ago** and the K-T (also called K-Pg) extinction at **66 million years ago**. The death rates are estimates and differ a little between sources.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
buildQuiz("u2o-extinction-quiz", "💀 Check Your Understanding — Mass Extinctions", [
  {
    q: "Which mass extinction had the highest death rate?",
    options: ["Ordovician (85%)", "Permian (95%)", "K-T (80%)", "Devonian (70%)"],
    correct: 1,
    explanation: "The Permian extinction, about 250 million years ago, wiped out about 95% of species. It is often called 'the Great Dying.'"
  },
  {
    q: "Which cause appears in BOTH the Permian and Triassic extinctions?",
    options: ["Asteroid impact", "Falling sea levels", "An increase in methane and CO₂ causing rapid global warming", "Rapid global cooling"],
    correct: 2,
    explanation: "Both list an increase in methane and CO₂ and rapid global warming. Not every mass extinction was caused by an asteroid."
  },
  {
    q: "Based on the poster, which statement is best supported?",
    options: ["All mass extinctions were caused by asteroids", "Rapid climate change (warming or cooling) shows up in most of the extinctions", "Mass extinctions happen every 10 million years", "Extinctions only affected land animals"],
    correct: 1,
    explanation: "Rapid cooling (Ordovician, Devonian), rapid warming (Permian, Triassic), and an impact 'nuclear winter' (K-T) all involve fast climate change. Asteroids appear in only two of the five."
  }
])
```

::: {.key-idea}
### 💡 What the timeline shows

- Life appeared **early** (within about 500 million years), but it stayed **single-celled for billions of years**.
- Oxygen had to build up first: earliest oxygen (~3,500 Mya), then oxygen in the atmosphere (~2,400 Mya).
- Complex animals appear only in the **last ~600 million years**. Humans appear in the last **0.3 million**.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
buildQuiz("u2o-timeline-quiz", "🧬 Check Your Understanding — Life Timeline", [
  {
    q: "According to the timeline, about how long after Earth formed did the earliest life appear?",
    options: ["About 5 million years", "About 500 million years", "About 2 billion years", "About 4.5 billion years"],
    correct: 1,
    explanation: "Earth formed ~4,540 Mya and the earliest life appears ~4,000 Mya: a gap of roughly 500 million years. Life started fairly quickly. Complex life took much longer."
  },
  {
    q: "Which event had to happen in the atmosphere before complex, multicellular life appeared?",
    options: ["Oxygen built up in the atmosphere", "All the water evaporated", "The dinosaurs went extinct", "Flowers evolved"],
    correct: 0,
    explanation: "Atmospheric oxygen appears ~2,400 Mya, well before eukaryotes (~1,850 Mya) and multicellular life (~1,600 Mya). Oxygen is a big part of this unit's story."
  },
  {
    q: "Zoom to the last 600 million years. Which group appeared most recently?",
    options: ["Tetrapods", "Dinosaurs", "Flowers", "Modern humans"],
    correct: 3,
    explanation: "Modern humans appear only ~0.3 million years ago, at the far right edge. On the full 4.54-billion-year scale, that dot sits almost exactly on 'today'."
  }
])
```

## Overall Story of the Phenomenon

::: {.student-task}
### ✏️ In your packet: Tell the Story (pp. 3–6)

- For **each text** (Text 1, Text 2, Text 3), write **three important details** on the lines.
- Share with your group, then list **at least 5 important details your group surfaced**.
- Write the **Overall Story of the Phenomenon** based on your group's discussion. *What is the phenomenon?*
:::

::: {.key-idea}
### 💡 One way to tell the story

Life began on Earth early, but for billions of years it stayed simple. Oxygen slowly built up, cells became more complex, and only in the last ~600 million years did large, complex life spread. Along the way, **five mass extinctions** wiped out 70–95% of species. **Humans appeared only ~300,000 years ago, after about 4.5 billion years.**
:::

# Introduction to the Unit Performance Task: Are We Alone?

::: {.explore-box}
## 👽 Are We Alone?

**Does life exist somewhere outside of Earth? What about life that has technology and can communicate like humans?**

4.5 billion years passed and **5 mass extinctions** occurred before humans appeared on Earth. So far we have yet to come in contact with any other beings from another planet, or even find evidence that proves any sort of life exists elsewhere.

**So are we alone?**
:::

::: {.key-idea}
### 🎯 Your task in this unit

Work with classmates to **investigate some factors that influence the evolution of life on Earth** and **explain why modern humans' emergence on Earth required nearly 4.5 billion years.** Then use your findings to **make and defend an argument about the probability of intelligent life existing somewhere outside Earth.**
:::

### ⏰ How long is 4.5 billion years? The Earth Clock

Squeeze all of Earth's history into one 24-hour day. Earth forms at midnight. Pick an event to see when it happens on the clock.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof clockEvent = Inputs.select(lifeTimeline.map(d => d.event), {label: "Event:", value: "Modern humans"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const ev = lifeTimeline.find(d => d.event === clockEvent);
  const totalSec = 86400;
  const secAfter = totalSec * (1 - ev.mya / 4540);
  const secBefore = totalSec - secAfter;
  const hh = Math.floor(secAfter / 3600), mm = Math.floor((secAfter % 3600) / 60), ss = Math.floor(secAfter % 60);
  const clockStr = `${String(hh).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(mm).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(ss).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  const beforeStr = secBefore < 60 ? `${secBefore.toFixed(1)} seconds` : secBefore < 3600 ? `${(secBefore / 60).toFixed(1)} minutes` : `${(secBefore / 3600).toFixed(1)} hours`;

  const W = 360, H = 250, cx = 120, cy = 125, r = 95;
  const svg = d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`)
    .style("width", "100%").style("max-width", "560px").style("height", "auto").style("display", "block").style("margin", "auto");
  svg.append("rect").attr("width", W).attr("height", H).attr("rx", 12).attr("fill", "#0a0a2e");
  svg.append("circle").attr("cx", cx).attr("cy", cy).attr("r", r).attr("fill", "#13134a").attr("stroke", "#a29bfe").attr("stroke-width", 2);
  // 24-hour clock: midnight at top
  const ang = h => (h / 24) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2;
  for (let h = 0; h < 24; h += 3) {
    svg.append("text").attr("x", cx + (r - 14) * Math.cos(ang(h))).attr("y", cy + (r - 14) * Math.sin(ang(h)) + 4)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("fill", "#9aa7bd").attr("font-size", 10).text(h === 0 ? "0/24" : h);
  }
  // shaded arc: time with complex life (last ~600 My)
  const arc = d3.arc().innerRadius(r - 4).outerRadius(r + 4);
  svg.append("path").attr("transform", `translate(${cx},${cy})`)
    .attr("d", arc({startAngle: (1 - 600 / 4540) * 2 * Math.PI, endAngle: 2 * Math.PI})).attr("fill", "#00b894");
  const a = ang(secAfter / 3600);
  svg.append("line").attr("x1", cx).attr("y1", cy).attr("x2", cx + (r - 22) * Math.cos(a)).attr("y2", cy + (r - 22) * Math.sin(a))
    .attr("stroke", "#fdcb6e").attr("stroke-width", 4).attr("stroke-linecap", "round");
  svg.append("circle").attr("cx", cx).attr("cy", cy).attr("r", 5).attr("fill", "#fdcb6e");
  const tx = 232;
  svg.append("text").attr("x", tx).attr("y", 70).attr("fill", "white").attr("font-size", 14).attr("font-weight", "bold").text(ev.event);
  svg.append("text").attr("x", tx).attr("y", 105).attr("fill", "#fdcb6e").attr("font-size", 26).attr("font-weight", "bold").text(clockStr);
  svg.append("text").attr("x", tx).attr("y", 130).attr("fill", "#dfe6e9").attr("font-size", 11).text(`${beforeStr}`);
  svg.append("text").attr("x", tx).attr("y", 146).attr("fill", "#dfe6e9").attr("font-size", 11).text("before midnight");
  svg.append("text").attr("x", tx).attr("y", 185).attr("fill", "#00b894").attr("font-size", 10).text("Green arc = last 600 My");
  svg.append("text").attr("x", tx).attr("y", 199).attr("fill", "#00b894").attr("font-size", 10).text("(complex animal life)");
  return svg.node();
}
```

<div class="mind-blown">
🧠 On the Earth Clock, modern humans show up only about <b>6 seconds before midnight</b>. Life is ancient. Intelligent life is brand new.
</div>

# Developing an Initial Explanation

::: {.explain-box}
## 🧩 What set of conditions allowed for the evolution of humans on Earth, and why did it take so long?

Use the important details from the Tell the Story texts. With your group, sort **factors that support** the existence and evolution of life from **factors that prevent or limit** it. Then explain what **combination** of these factors could have resulted in intelligent life on Earth.
:::

### 🗂️ Factor Sorter

Decide whether each factor **supports**, **limits**, or does **both** for the evolution of life. Then compare your choice with how scientists see it. There is no score; this is a thinking warm-up for your model.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
lifeFactors = [
  {f: "💧 Liquid water on Earth's surface (from ~4,400 Mya)", key: "Supports", why: "Every living thing on Earth needs liquid water. Earth had oceans very early, before the earliest life appeared."},
  {f: "☄️ Frequent asteroid impacts early in Earth's history", key: "Limits", why: "Early Earth was heavily bombarded. Large impacts can boil oceans and sterilize the surface, which may have delayed life. You'll study this in Stability of the Solar System."},
  {f: "🌱 Photosynthesis adding oxygen to the atmosphere", key: "Both", why: "Oxygen made complex, energy-hungry life possible, but the 'oxygen crisis' (~2,300 Mya) killed many early microbes that could not handle it."},
  {f: "💀 Five mass extinctions", key: "Both", why: "Each wiped out 70–95% of species, but survivors filled the empty niches. After the K-T extinction ended the dinosaurs, mammals (and later humans) spread."},
  {f: "🔥 Rapid global warming from methane and CO₂", key: "Limits", why: "The Permian (95%) and Triassic (76%) extinctions list rapid warming, oxygen-poor oceans, and desertification."},
  {f: "❄️ Rapid global cooling and falling sea levels", key: "Limits", why: "The Ordovician (85%) extinction: coastal habitats were destroyed and cold slowed chemical reactions."},
  {f: "🧫 Cells with a nucleus (eukaryotes, ~1,850 Mya)", key: "Supports", why: "Eukaryotic cells are larger and more complex. All multicellular life, including humans, is built from them."},
  {f: "🧬 Sexual reproduction (~1,200 Mya)", key: "Supports", why: "Mixing genes from two parents creates more variation, so evolution can move faster."},
  {f: "🌋 Volcanic activity", key: "Both", why: "Volcanoes released gases that helped build the early atmosphere and oceans, but huge eruptions are linked to the Permian and K-T extinctions."},
  {f: "☀️ A stable Sun shining for billions of years", key: "Supports", why: "From Unit 1: a long-lived, steady star gives life billions of years of stable energy to evolve."}
]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const wrap = html`<div style="margin:10px 0;"></div>`;
  const tally = html`<div style="text-align:center;font-weight:700;margin:8px 0 14px;">Sorted: <span>0</span> / ${lifeFactors.length} · Matched scientists: <span>0</span></div>`;
  wrap.appendChild(tally);
  let sorted = 0, matched = 0;
  const colors = {Supports: "#00b894", Limits: "#d63031", Both: "#6c5ce7"};
  lifeFactors.forEach(item => {
    const card = html`<div style="background:#fff;color:#1e1b4b;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1);">
      <div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;">${item.f}</div>
      <div class="btns" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;"></div>
      <div class="fb" style="font-size:.92em;"></div>
    </div>`;
    const btns = card.querySelector(".btns"), fb = card.querySelector(".fb");
    ["Supports", "Limits", "Both"].forEach(choice => {
      const b = html`<button style="flex:1 1 90px;min-height:44px;border:2px solid ${colors[choice]};border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:${colors[choice]};font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">${choice}</button>`;
      b.onclick = () => {
        if (card.dataset.done) return;
        card.dataset.done = "1";
        sorted++;
        const ok = choice === item.key;
        if (ok) matched++;
        b.style.background = colors[choice]; b.style.color = "#fff";
        btns.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(x => x.style.cursor = "default");
        fb.style.cssText = `margin-top:8px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:${ok ? "#f0fff4" : "#f5f3ff"};color:#1e1b4b;`;
        fb.innerHTML = `<b>${ok ? "✅ Scientists agree:" : "🤔 Scientists would say:"} ${item.key}.</b> ${item.why}`;
        tally.querySelectorAll("span")[0].textContent = sorted;
        tally.querySelectorAll("span")[1].textContent = matched;
      };
      btns.appendChild(b);
    });
    wrap.appendChild(card);
  });
  return wrap;
}
```
